rules.label: More than 8 characters long
rules.description: Password must be at least 9 characters in length.

rules.label: At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
rules.description: Must include at least one capital letter.

rules.label: At least one lowercase letter (a-z)
rules.description: Must include at least one small letter.

rules.label: At least one special character
rules.description: Must include at least one non-alphanumeric character (e.g. !@#$%^&*).
